arabicExcerpts.text: وَيَوۡمَ يُحۡشَرُ أَعۡدَآءُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَهُمۡ يُوزَعُونَ
حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا مَا جَآءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَمۡعُهُمۡ وَأَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ وَجُلُودُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
وَقَالُواْ لِجُلُودِهِمۡ لِمَ شَهِدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡنَاۖ قَالُوٓاْ أَنطَقَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖۚ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
وَمَا كُنتُمۡ تَسۡتَتِرُونَ أَن يَشۡهَدَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ سَمۡعُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَبۡصَٰرُكُمۡ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن ظَنَنتُمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَعۡلَمُ كَثِيرٗا مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
وَذَٰلِكُمۡ ظَنُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِي ظَنَنتُم بِرَبِّكُمۡ أَرۡدَىٰكُمۡ فَأَصۡبَحۡتُم مِّنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
فَإِن يَصۡبِرُواْ فَٱلنَّارُ مَثۡوٗى لَّهُمۡۖ وَإِن يَسۡتَعۡتِبُواْ فَمَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُعۡتَبِينَ

۞وَقَيَّضۡنَا لَهُمۡ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَيَّنُواْ لَهُم مَّا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَحَقَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ فِيٓ أُمَمٖ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ خَٰسِرِينَ
وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَسۡمَعُواْ لِهَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَٱلۡغَوۡاْ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَغۡلِبُونَ
فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدٗا وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ أَسۡوَأَ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ أَعۡدَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّارُۖ لَهُمۡ فِيهَا دَارُ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُونَ
وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَرِنَا ٱلَّذَيۡنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ نَجۡعَلۡهُمَا تَحۡتَ أَقۡدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُواْ وَلَا تَحۡزَنُواْ وَأَبۡشِرُواْ بِٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ
نَحۡنُ أَوۡلِيَآؤُكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيٓ أَنفُسُكُمۡ وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ

mainSubject.label: The gathering of Allah's enemies to the Fire in driven rows; bodily testimony of hearing, eyes and skins against their owners, answered by the skins' declaration that Allah made them speak as He created them first; the failure to conceal from one's own faculties rooted in the assumption that Allah does not know much of what they do, an assumption bringing ruin; patience and appeasement both useless in the Fire; appointed companions beautifying sin until the word takes effect among prior nations of jinn and men; the tactic of noisy disruption during recitation answered by severe punishment and recompense for the worst; the Fire as eternal home for rejecting verses; the plea to trample misleading jinn and men; against this, those who say our Lord is Allah and remain steadfast receive descending angels with fear-grief removal and Paradise tidings, angelic alliance in both realms, fulfilled desires and requests as accommodation from the Forgiving Merciful

subordinateSubjects.label: The Day the enemies of Allah are gathered to the Fire, driven and assembled in rows
On reaching it their hearing, eyes and skins testify against them concerning their deeds
Their question to their skins answered by the declaration that Allah made them speak as He made everything speak and created them first
Their failure to conceal from their own faculties, rooted in the assumption that Allah does not know much of what they do
That assumption about their Lord named as the cause of ruin and loss
Patience availing nothing in the Fire, and requests to appease refused
Appointed companions beautifying what was before and behind them until the word took effect among prior nations of jinn and men
The disbelievers' instruction not to listen to the Quran and to speak noisily during recitation to overcome it
Severe punishment promised with recompense for the worst of their deeds
The Fire named the recompense of Allah's enemies and their home of eternity for rejecting His verses
Their plea to be shown the jinn and men who misled them so they may trample them lowest
Those who say our Lord is Allah and remain on a right course receiving descending angels with fear and grief removed and Paradise tidings
Angelic alliance in worldly life and the Hereafter with whatever souls desire and request granted
That state named accommodation from a Forgiving and Merciful Lord

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the saving of believers from Thamud's thunderbolt (18) before the enemies-gathering scene opens (19); P2 ends with the angelic accommodation promise (32); P3 runs from the best-speech question through the individual-recompense principle (33-46); P4 begins with Hour-knowledge exclusivity and closes with the encompassing-witness affirmation (47-54).
